verdict.rationale: ADK is an agent framework rather than an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair axis to ask about. The pack shows no first-party hosted or shipped ADK MCP server. The MCP evidence covers ADK agents acting as MCP clients, plus a guide for developers to build their own MCP server wrapping ADK tools. That guide is a developer building block, not an official server, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
